Site: >=50 R trees with DP>=15; carriers (both alleles >=2 reads) >= 90% of those and >=10; panel median DP (R trees with DP>=15) x9 in [100, 99th pct of that quantity over qualifying non-chr4 sites] (cap after floor); Neale 1-Mb block purity >=0.90 with majority chrom = SNP chrom. exact_definition: Per pool and site: f = sum AO / sum (RO+AO) over the pool; p_hat = same over R minus the pool's own trees; n = pool depth; D2 = (f-p_hat)^2/(p_hat(1-p_hat)) - 1/n. T = (mean D2 chr4 - mean D2 other ten)/SE, SE = delete-one-block jackknife over 25-Mb SEGI blocks (all chromosomes).

10,000 pseudo-clones of 9 R trees without replacement, PCR-group composition = stems (g1:2, g2:1, g3:3, g4:1, g5:2), seed 20261027; same sites and rules; p = (1 + #{T_pseudo >= T_clone})/10,001, one-sided.
Clone: for each non-chr4 chromosome c, T_c = (mean D2 on c - mean D2 on the other nine non-chr4 chromosomes)/SE_jk (same jackknife).

Spike the clone's own chromosome c (each of 10 non-chr4): random fraction pi of its used sites gets pooled AO shifted by +/- delta*n (random sign, round, clip to [0,n]), no resampling; recompute T_c. Grid pi {0.25,0.33,0.50} x delta {1/15,2/15,1/6}; 100 seeds per chromosome and grid point (seed 20261027+k). Power = share of the 1,000 spiked T_c >= 99.9th percentile of the A9 pseudo-clone null.

SUPPORTS iff p<0.001 AND T_chr4 > max_c T_c AND A8(i) robust. CONTRADICTS iff power(0.33,1/15) >= 0.80 AND p>0.20 AND T_chr4 <= clone's 90th percentile of T_c. Else INCONCLUSIVE with code: U (p>=0.001, power<0.80), M (p<0.001 but some T_c >= T_chr4), R (p<0.001, A8(i) fails), N (power>=0.80, 0.001<=p<=0.20).
decision_rule_or_use: primary A call; CONTRADICTS -> stop and discuss with Sasha

exact_definition: (i) A9 on sites with panel median DP x9 >= 200, own 2,000-pseudo-clone null (seed 20261028): robust iff one-sided p<0.01. (ii) leave-one-stem-out (9) and without pilot stems 14_WP3, 22_WPd2: T and p vs the primary null (descriptive). (iii) single- vs multi-Neale-locus SEGI 1-kb loci (rv05 stratifier): T per stratum (descriptive; predicted larger at single-locus).
Clone-het: pooled min(ref,alt)>=5, each allele >=1 read in >=2 stems; panel median DP x9 in [100, cap] (A9 rule); >=10 panel carriers (224 trees, DP>=15, both alleles >=2); Neale block purity rule.

Beta-binomial mixture: 11 peaks {1/6,1/5,1/4,1/3,2/5,1/2,3/5,2/3,3/4,4/5,5/6} + uniform background; p_alt = f/(f + r(1-f)); r grid 0.80-1.25 step 0.05, rho grid {0.002,0.005,0.01,0.02,0.04} by profile likelihood per chromosome; weights by EM from 20 Dirichlet starts (seed 20261027) + 1 equal-weight start, max 2,000 iterations, tol 1e-8, best kept; null = 5-only peaks fixed 0, started from the full fit, loglik_null <= loglik_full enforced. W5 = weight on {1/5,2/5,3/5,4/5}.

Fit 10 non-chr4 chromosomes; 200 block-bootstrap replicates over 10-Mb SEGI windows (seed 20261027), weights refitted at fixed (r,rho) from the best start. PASS iff bootstrap SD of W5 <= 0.03 on every non-chr4 chromosome AND no non-chr4 chromosome has W5 2.5th percentile > 0.03.
decision_rule_or_use: FAIL -> chr4 not fitted; lattice reported 'not identifiable in these data'

exact_definition: Fit chr4 likewise; dW5 = W5(chr4) - median W5(other ten), 95% block-bootstrap percentile CI. SUPPORTS(lattice) iff lower bound > 0 AND dW5 > every other chromosome's dW5_c. Single/multi Neale-locus and AB 0.30-0.70 versions descriptive.

exact_definition: U = mean + t(0.995, df 6) x SD x sqrt(1+1/7) over identity d_c. ONE GENET iff all 36 clone d_c <= U AND max clone d_c < min anchor d_c. Else AMBIGUOUS (batch-aligned if all out-of-bound pairs are within groups 1/3).
